name: Hidaka Akemi
source:
A shy and quiet girl, Akemi has been bullied for a long time, so, even at her new school, she tried to keep a low profile.

She has always tried to avoid contact with other people so as not to stand out. One day, she meets Chiaki, who cares about her, and they begin to get to know each other a little more.

For Akemi, who has been bullied since childhood Chiaki is the first person that Akemi can call a friend.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/ryomaden/index.html]official site[/url]]
